acceptanceCriteria: Define numbered UX presentation intent for AHI-033/034 before implementation; retain authority, exact evidence bindings, advisory scope and manual refresh semantics.
Permanent advisory/authority limitations remain accessible but do not inflate the actionable attention count; fixture tests cover no unknowns, missing checks, stale checks and real unknowns.
Sidebar and command-palette labels match the argument-free /corvint change destination; evidence navigation remains explicit and discoverable.
Use plain-language check and state labels, section-specific empty/recovery copy, and a contextual next action without implying correctness or execution authority.

Retain an independent review and actual pinned-host wide/compact keyboard/mouse witnesses, including loading, stale, empty and unavailable states; do not infer native qualification from the HTML concept.

Include a coherent Work-to-Change-to-Evidence flow sourced from the native Corvint Tasks store: selected ticket/revision, acceptance criteria, dependencies and holds, claim eligibility and attempt unknowns, required gates and their current bound observations.

Task completion reflects the successful native completion write and receipt readback after required gates and integration. Passing checks, no listed blockers, unknown liveness and stale snapshots never imply availability or completion. Work empty/unavailable states preserve the existing store and do not initialize or infer queue state.
